Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

University of Kota (UOK) has released the Answer Key for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) Exam 2026. Applications for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 14 June 2026 to 10 August 2026. The written examination was held on 13 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 June 2026
  • Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 07 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 05 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, SBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) of Rajasthan State and Out of State : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS, SBC, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) of Rajasthan State Candidates : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST of Rajasthan State and All PwD Candidates : Rs. 400/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
